meta.name: Dog the Bounty Hunter
meta.description:
Go on the prowl with real-life bounty hunter Duane Dog Chapman, his wife Beth, and their family as they chase down fugitives in the Hawaiian islands. The hunt is on, and Dog always gets his man on this exclusive 24/7 channel.

24/7: Dog the Bounty Hunter
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus, Tubi
